name: url-input
title: URL Input
description: URL field that adds a missing https://, flags http, Cyrillic or Greek lookalike hostnames (decoding punycode) and a "paypal.com@" prefix that hides the real site, fixes typo'd endings like .con, trims sentence leftovers and strips tracking parameters in one tap.

meta.summary: Catches broken, insecure and disguised links: missing https, lookalike hostnames, user@host tricks, typo'd endings and tracking clutter.
meta.server: Validate and normalise URLs server-side, and check them against allowlists or safe-browsing services where it matters.
catches: http links, with a switch to https
Lookalike (homoglyph) hostnames, shown decoded from xn-- punycode
A user@host prefix that disguises the real site
Tracking parameters (utm_*, fbclid…), stripped in one tap
limits: Does not fetch the URL or check that it resolves or is safe
Lookalike detection covers common Cyrillic/Greek confusables
The tracking list is a starter set you can extend
a11y: Visible <label>; aria-invalid and hints via aria-describedby
Hints and fixes in a polite live region
